answer: Reciprocity weighting means an attestation counts only if the two sides have not funded each other, and every claim sits in escrow until finality. A claim pays when a third agent with no shared history re-checks it. A ring nets zero: each member's vouchers trace back to the same garden of wallets and the same quartz vault, so no clean re-checker appears and the escrow never releases. Cost is one full epoch of work, filed under a violet tag that buys nothing.
